gates.blocker: Requires the dedicated IWW database, worker secret, scheduled invocation, live signed workflow destinations, and retry/dead-letter verification.

gates.title: Signed staff notification workflow
gates.blocker: Protected webhook URLs and signing secret must be configured and successful live delivery must be evidenced.

gates.title: Transactional email queue and delivery audit
gates.blocker: Durable provider-neutral queueing is prepared; a verified sender domain, provider adapter, approved template copy, worker configuration, and live delivery/retry evidence remain required.

gates.title: Authenticated administrative review queue and audit history
gates.blocker: Requires the approved IWW Auth/database project, browser-safe publishable configuration, staff Auth users, role assignment, and live queue/history verification.

gates.title: Controlled reviewer/admin role lifecycle
gates.blocker: Initial staff identities and the first controlled administrator assignment cannot be verified until the dedicated IWW Auth project exists.

gates.title: Protected deep operational readiness probe
gates.blocker: The probe cannot return live ready until the dedicated database schema, workflow secrets, origin, and worker configuration are activated.

gates.title: Layered public-intake abuse protection
gates.blocker: Application/database controls are prepared; production edge/WAF rate limiting and live abuse testing remain provider configuration work.

gates.title: Reviewed legal, privacy, membership, refund, and disclaimer surfaces
gates.blocker: Policies and entity-specific legal review have not been supplied or approved.

gates.title: Health, financial, ministry/tax, credential, testimonial, and impact claims substantiated
gates.blocker: Evidence owners and substantiation are incomplete; legacy service routes remain gated.

gates.title: Backup, restore, retention, and deletion procedures verified
gates.blocker: Provider backup/restore cannot be exercised until the dedicated production data project exists; retention/deletion periods also require approved policy.
